what: The name is covered with mask characters (X), and once is-resolved is applied it resolves over 2.2s power2.inOut, from the first letter onward, through shuffled letters into the real letters (letter i starts at progress (i/length)×.78 and runs for .22, shuffled letters change every 55ms and turn into the real letter with probability progress × .55). While masked, if the cursor comes within 8px of the text box, energy builds at 9/s and drains at 2.6/s after it leaves, and the real letter flickers with probability energy × .08 and a shuffled letter with × .42. On receiving fx:swap(detail.text), each letter lands at point (i/length)×.78+.22 over .5s and the text changes to the new one.

options.word: Name when solved (becomes the number of masked characters)
options.pool: Scramble character candidates, default is the name’s letters + #/+×
options.tick: Interval at which scrambled letters change (ms), default 55
options.on: state (default — is-resolved) · load (resolves as soon as it attaches)

use: XXXXXXXXXXXX · On reaching the last section el.classList.add("is-resolved") · If attached without a name, only fx:swap switching is used

from.where: Header line name (XXXXXXXXXXXX → resolves in 2.2s at the footer stop) · hero pair name (fx:swap .5s)

note: So the text width doesn’t jitter while mixing, white-space: pre is applied. With a non-monospaced font the width still shifts a little
